resources.string: Top-level page: %1$s\nThis page or an embedded frame can receive the selected file, up to 32 MiB. No camera or folder access. When you leave this tab or app, the page is unloaded before the private copy is removed. Reload the page before choosing another attachment.
Attachment unavailable. Choose one file up to 32 MiB on a loaded HTTPS page; reload before attaching another. Cameras and folders are not supported.
Host: %1$s\nOpen this HTTPS address in a new regular tab? Nothing is loaded before confirmation. Form data and app-provided headers are not forwarded.

Host: %1$s\nOpen this HTTPS address in a new private tab? Nothing is loaded before confirmation. Form data and app-provided headers are not forwarded. Private mode cannot erase the original link from other apps or the operating system.
Library storage is unavailable. Existing data was not changed.
Delete all regular browsing history in Forge? Bookmarks, saved tabs, cookies and exported files stay. This is not secure erasure.
Bookmark could not be added. Private pages and unsupported addresses are not saved; the limit is 200.
Sharing reveals this private tab address to the chosen app or person. Forge cannot erase copies outside the browser. Nothing is sent until you choose a destination.
No application is available to share this link.
Page search is unavailable. Try again after loading the page.
Could not connect. Check your network and try again.
Secure connection failed. No certificate exception was added.
This page was blocked by browser security. Protection was not disabled.
GeckoView prototype — HTTPS only. Not desktop Forge.
Unsupported address or navigation. Only HTTPS is enabled.
Page could not be loaded. No certificate exception was added.
Close every private tab and discard this private browsing group?
Saved tab restored. Tap Reload to load the page.
Session storage is unavailable. Existing saved data was not changed.
Download this file? Maximum 256 MiB. Leaving the app cancels the transfer.
File saved. It was not opened.
Download failed. Check the network and available space, then retry from the page.
Could not save the file. Choose another destination and retry.
Download blocked: unsupported response, size limit, or another file is pending.
Downloads are unavailable in private browsing.

Clear cookies, cache and website storage in all Forge windows? This signs you out, unloads pages, closes private tabs and cancels downloads. Regular tab addresses, bookmarks, history and exported files stay. Clear history separately. OS permissions are not reset.
Site data cleared. Reload a tab to open it.
Site data could not be fully cleared. Try again.
Finish exporting the file before clearing site data.

Current tab: %1$s\n\nContinue to the system camera or microphone permission for Forge? This does not grant website access. A separate site confirmation follows. System permission also applies outside private browsing.
%1$s requests: %2$s.\n\nAllow this page to use the device? No remembered site decision is saved by Forge. Access stops when this tab is left or Forge goes into the background.
This site permission is not supported in this build. Access was denied.

Check razex.shop for a signed development update? Your IP address and update request reach the server; no tabs, cookies or history are sent. Checks are manual only. This channel retains the existing debug signing identity, not a production release key.
No newer compatible update is available.
Version %1$s · approximately %2$d MiB. Download over your current connection? Installation requires separate confirmation.
Download verified: hash, size, package, higher version and matching signing certificate. Open the Android installer? Your profile will not be deleted.

Android requires permission to install updates from Forge. You may enable it in system settings, then return and check again. No protections will be bypassed. Disable the permission after use if desired.
Update could not be verified or downloaded. Nothing was installed. Check your connection and device clock, then reopen this dialog. Do not uninstall Forge to bypass a signature mismatch.
